blocks.heading: Business Automation that *Saves You Hours*
blocks.lead: We map your workflows, find the bottlenecks, and build automated systems so your team spends time on what actually matters — growing the business, not feeding spreadsheets.

header.title: Stop doing tasks *machines can do*
header.subtitle: Every hour your team spends on repetitive work is an hour not spent on growth.

items.title: CRM Automation
items.body: Automated lead routing, follow-up sequences, deal stage updates, and pipeline management — your CRM runs itself.

items.title: Invoice & Billing
items.body: Auto-generate invoices on trigger, send payment reminders, reconcile payments, and update accounting tools without lifting a finger.

items.title: Email Workflows
items.body: Drip campaigns, onboarding sequences, win-back flows, and internal alert systems that run 24/7 based on user behaviour.

items.title: Reporting & Alerts
items.body: Auto-generated weekly reports sent to your inbox. Exception alerts when KPIs go off track — so you act before it's a problem.

items.title: Scheduling & Booking
items.body: Automated calendar management, appointment reminders, and rescheduling flows that eliminate back-and-forth entirely.

items.title: Data Sync
items.body: Keep all your tools talking to each other in real time — CRM, accounting, e-commerce, support, and more, perfectly in sync.

header.title: Automation done *properly*
header.subtitle: We don't bolt on tools — we redesign workflows from the ground up for efficiency.

items.title: Workflow Mapping
items.body: We document every current process, identify waste, and calculate the time cost of manual tasks to prioritise highest-ROI automations first.

items.title: Tool Selection
items.body: We pick the right automation stack for your specific needs, budget, and tech environment — not a one-size-fits-all solution.

items.title: Build & Test
items.body: Automations are built with thorough testing, error handling, and failsafes so nothing breaks when edge cases occur in real use.

items.title: Train & Hand Off
items.body: Team training, documentation, and a handoff session so your team fully owns the new workflows — not dependent on us forever.

items.title: Web Development
items.body: Automate the tech behind your site

blocks.heading: Ready to stop doing *busy work?*
blocks.body: Book a free workflow audit. We'll identify your top 3 automation opportunities and estimate exactly how much time you'll get back.
